name: Theraplo
author: theraplo

sections.description:
Theraplo seamlessly integrates appointment booking functionality into WordPress websites for therapy practices and healthcare professionals. It connects to your Firebase backend services and provides multiple ways to embed booking calendars.

External Services Used:

This plugin connects to Firebase (Google Cloud Platform) to store and retrieve appointment data. Firebase is used for:
– Real-time appointment scheduling
– User/practitioner data storage
– Service and location information

You must have a Firebase account and configure your Firebase project settings to use this plugin. Data is transmitted to and from Firebase servers (firebaseapp.com and firebasestorage.app) when using the booking functionality.

Firebase Privacy Policy: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
Firebase Terms of Service: https://firebase.google.com/terms

Key Features

  • Multiple Integration Methods: Shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, WordPress widgets, and Elementor widgets
  • Firebase Backend Integration: Real-time data synchronization with Firebase
  • Specialist-Specific Calendars: Individual booking calendars for each practitioner
  • Service and Location Filtering: Pre-filter appointments by service type and location
  • Responsive Design: Mobile-friendly with customizable styling
  • Admin Interface: Easy configuration and real-time data browsing
  • Real-time Data Browser: Browse specialists, services, and locations directly from WordPress admin

Integration Options

Shortcodes:
* [theraplo-full] – Full calendar view
* [theraplo-user data-id="specialist-id"] – User-specific calendar

Gutenberg Block:
* Theraplo Calendar block with visual editor controls

WordPress Widget:
* Available in Appearance > Widgets

Elementor Widget:
* Available in Elementor page builder

Who Is This For?

  • Therapy practices
  • Healthcare professionals
  • Wellness centers
  • Individual therapists
  • Medical clinics
  • Any appointment-based business
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Theraplo”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. You’ll see a welcome notice – click “Complete setup”
  5. Add your Theraplo configuration and start using widgets!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Theraplo > Setup to configure

Quick Start

After activation, you’ll see:
– Welcome notice with setup link
– “Settings” link on plugins page
– New “Theraplo” menu in WordPress admin

For Elementor Users

  • Install and activate Elementor
  • Look for “Theraplo Calendar” widget in Elementor’s widget panel
  • Drag and drop to use!

Need Help?

Visit the Introduction page (Theraplo > Introduction) for complete documentation and examples.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Theraplo account?

Yes, you need a Theraplo account with Firebase configuration to use this plugin. The plugin connects to your Firebase backend to display real-time booking data.

What Firebase collections are supported?

The plugin reads from these Firebase collections:
* publicUsers – Specialists/practitioners
* publicServices – Available services
* publicLocations – Office locations
* customerProblems – Problem categories

Can I customize the calendar appearance?

Yes, you can add custom CSS in the Theraplo > Advanced settings page to style the calendar according to your needs.

Is this compatible with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme. The calendars are responsive and will adapt to your theme’s styling.
